_comment: Limits for resuming a reopened DME session (lib/dme-resume-context.js). rebuiltContextCharacterBudget: the most saved-turn text prepended to one prompt when a conversation is rebuilt; the newest turns that fit are kept and the user is told how many were left out (about 100k tokens at 4 characters a token, inside the models' context window with room for tools and the answer). savedTurnCountLimit: the most saved turns one prompt may carry; more is refused by name.
